headline: Sony revives its classic 1979 Walkman headphone design
summary: Sony is reviving its original Walkman-era headphone design, dating to 1979, in the new MDR-3R model, which adds USB-C and comes with orange ear cushions.

claims.statement: Sony is reviving its classic 1979 headphone design in the new MDR-3R.

sources.quote: Sony's MDR-3R wired headphones are steeped in retro aesthetics
Sony has refreshed a headphone design that dates back to 1979.
Sony revives the original Walkman headphones

claims.statement: The headphones include orange ear cushions.
